title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: PGA Tour Scheduling Shake-Up
items.text: CEO Brian Rolapp plans to move AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am and Genesis Invitational to August to strengthen late-season fields and build momentum into the FedEx Cup Playoffs.

items.headline: Wyndham Championship Field Changes
items.text: Kristoffer Reitan, Brendon Todd, Dan Brown, and Michael Thorbjornsen withdrew from the Wyndham Championship, replaced by Kris Ventura, Matt Kuchar, Lanto Griffin, and Justin Lower; Zac Blair granted final unrestricted exemption.
